title: Unexported variable overridden by last exported value
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da]
v4.6.2.rc1.official [257ac3532]
v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

Changing a script's variable, has no effect when running a scene, after unexporting the variable, by removing `@export `.

Expected:
Unexporting a variable should start checking the script variable's value.

Cause:
The last exported variable change in the inspector, remains in the scene file (.tscn), and it overrides any script variable changes. 
The scene doesn't save and remove the unexported variable, when:
- running the scene
- or closing and reopening the project 

Workaround:
Saving the scene manually before or after reopening the project, removes the last exported variable change from the scene file.

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [unexported-variable-overridden-by-last-exported-value.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25969074/unexported-variable-overridden-by-last-exported-value.zip)
- open the script: `node_2d.gd`
- in the script, note the variable's value `1`: `@export var a = 1`
- select the node: `Node2D`
- in the inspector, note the exported variable `A`'s value: `2`
- run the scene
- stop the scene
- the output panel shows the exported value: `2`
- in the script, unexport the variable, by removing: `@export `
  Before: `@export var a = 1`
  After: `var a = 1`
- the exported variable `A` disappears from the inspector
- run the scene
- stop the scene

Issue: The output panel still shows the last exported value: `2`
Expected: The output panel should show the script variable's current value: `1`

Try again:
- in the script, change the variable's value, ex: `var a = 3`
- run the scene
- stop the scene

Issue: the output panel still shows the last exported value: `2`
Expected: The output panel should show the script variable's current value: `3`

Cause:
The scene file: `node_2d.tscn` still has the last exported variable change: `a = 2`
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://bgda5112j2408"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://mgctpbmubjs3" path="res://node_2d.gd" id="1_wtcfe"]

[node name="Node2D" type="Node2D" unique_id=1756748711]
script = ExtResource("1_wtcfe")
a = 2
```

Workaround:
Saving the scene manually, before or after reopening the project, removes the last exported variable:
- `ctrl + s`
- `Scene > Save Scene `
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://bgda5112j2408"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://mgctpbmubjs3" path="res://node_2d.gd" id="1_wtcfe"]

[node name="Node2D" type="Node2D" unique_id=1756748711]
script = ExtResource("1_wtcfe")
```

Now the output panel shows the script variable's current value, when the scene runs.

Notes:
The scene file doesn't seem to recognize that the variable has been unexported.

The scene should auto save when the scene runs.
According to the mouse over popup, on the setting:
Editor Settings > General > Run > Auto Save > Save Before Running
> Setting run/auto_save/save_before_running: bool
If true, saves all scenes and scripts automatically before running the project. Setting this to
false prevents the editor from saving if there are no changes which can speed up the
project startup slightly, but it makes it possible to run a project that has unsaved changes.
(Unsaved changes will not be visible in the running project.)

'Save Before Running' has not been changed from its default value: enabled

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[unexported-variable-overridden-by-last-exported-value.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25969074/unexported-variable-overridden-by-last-exported-value.zip)
